FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE - November 28, 2026
ANTIPOP PREMIERES 'Paradise (Thailand)' BY MARTIN STRAYD AS TODAY'S SINGLE OF THE DAY

GLOBAL DAILY SINGLES LAUNCH CAMPAIGN: Broadcast by ANNA and hosted by Veg Anna, station ANTIPOP today officially premieres 'Paradise (Thailand)' by Martin Strayd as its featured Single of the Day. The release anchors an ongoing daily singles launch campaign built around one artist, one new song per day, and continuous global discovery across an expanding catalog of more than 100 original studio recordings and licensed tracks.

ABOUT THE SINGLE AND SONG STORY: Centered on unstoppable creative overdrive and modern life, 'Paradise (Thailand)' blends story-driven songwriting, sharp observation, and radio-ready production. Rather than treating music as a disposable one-day upload, ANTIPOP pairs each daily single with dedicated Veg Anna radio intros, cover artwork, and searchable catalog documentation so listeners and music programmers worldwide can explore the narrative behind every release.

WORLD RADIO BROADCAST FOOTPRINT: Martin Strayd's catalog enjoys active world radio airplay reaching audiences across 10 countries: Philippines, Australia, Ecuador, United States, Chile, Canada, Indonesia, France, Thailand, and United Kingdom. Through continuous radio rotation and daily single premieres, international listeners experience each new release as part of a connected, living broadcast schedule.

ABOUT MARTIN STRAYD: Martin Strayd is an Australian lyricist, songwriter, and composer, and a former Hollywood celebrity guitar technician who worked backstage for rock legends including Steve Jones of the Sex Pistols and Doug Fieger of The Knack before channeling his personal experiences into his own recording career. Operating independently without traditional major-label gatekeepers, his sprawling catalog spans radio rock, anti-pop, reggae, blues, and electronic dance floor remixes exploring modern life, freedom, rebellion, and love.

DIRECT FAN OWNERSHIP AND NON-COMMERCIAL SHARING MODEL: Under the self-built artist-under-one-roof business model, listeners who purchase MP3 and cover art bundles own their files directly and are explicitly authorized to copy and share them freely with friends for non-commercial listening. Commercial resale, redistribution for profit, or unauthorized monetization of the audio files or artwork is strictly prohibited.

This is Veg Anna for ANNA, and this is your Single of the Day.","press":"ANTIPOP and Veg Anna Radio Drop Martin Strayd's Paradise as Today's Single of the Day: A Global Daily Singles Campaign Redefines Independent Music Discovery

Veg Anna Radio, the flagship station of ANTIPOP, is thrilled to announce that Paradise has been selected as Single of the Day for November 28, 2026. Martin Strayd, the Australian lyricist, songwriter, and composer behind the track, delivers a searing portrait of unstoppable creative energy colliding with the relentless pace of modern life. Paradise arrives as the latest chapter in a groundbreaking daily singles campaign that sees one fresh Martin Strayd song unleashed upon the world every single day, drawing from a catalog now exceeding one hundred recordings. Listeners across ten world radio countries are invited to experience the single immediately on Veg Anna Radio and through the official MP3 and cover art bundle now available online.

Paradise is not a travel postcard. It is a raw, electric dispatch from the front lines of a creative mind that refuses to slow down. The track captures the intoxicating fever of a songwriter who knows that paradise is not a destination but a state of work, of motion, of being so deeply alive in the act of creation that the rest of the world fades to static. Within the sprawling universe of Martin Strayd's catalog, which spans rock, alternative, anti-pop, reggae, blues, dance remixes, and cinematic soundtrack themes, Paradise occupies a striking space, blending driving rhythm with introspective lyricism to speak directly to anyone who has ever burned the midnight oil chasing something only they can see. The song resonates because its theme is universal: the beautiful obsession that defines the modern creative experience.

The global footprint of this campaign is nothing short of extraordinary. Paradise is broadcasting simultaneously across ten world radio countries, reaching listeners in the Philippines, Australia, Ecuador, the United States, Chile, Canada, Indonesia, France, Thailand, and the United Kingdom. Whether you are riding the MRT in Manila, driving the outback roads of New South Wales, navigating the autumn streets of Paris, or tuning in from a high-rise in Bangkok, the signal from Veg Anna Radio and ANNA finds you. This is world radio in its truest sense, built not on corporate gatekeeping but on the independent vision of one artist and one broadcaster committed to delivering daily musical moments that transcend borders, time zones, and genre conventions.

Martin Strayd's journey to this moment is one of the most compelling origin stories in independent music. Before he became the architect of a catalog that now numbers over one hundred songs, Martin worked backstage in Hollywood as a celebrity guitar technician, serving the instrument needs of rock legends including Steve Jones of the Sex Pistols and Doug Fieger of The Knack. That vantage point inside the machinery of rock and pop gave him an education no music school could provide. He learned what separates memorable from magnificent, and he carried that knowledge with him when he stepped out from behind the scenes to become the main event. Today, as an independent artist, Martin writes, records, and releases his own material on his own terms, and the daily singles campaign on Veg Anna Radio represents the purest expression of that philosophy. No label middlemen, no release windows, no artificial drought. Just music, every single day.

A cornerstone of this campaign is the direct ownership model that puts listeners in control of their music experience. Every MP3 and cover art bundle purchased from the official link grants the buyer full ownership of the digital files, which means the listener can share Paradise and any other single with friends for non-commercial listening purposes absolutely free of charge. This is music that belongs in your circle, passed hand to hand, streamed on road trips and kitchen playlists and late-night study sessions. Commercial resale of the files, however, is strictly prohibited, protecting the integrity of the artist's work and ensuring that the gift of music remains a gift and not a commodity traded on secondary markets. The catalog is an empire of sound, and every listener who joins the network becomes a trusted custodian of that empire.

Listeners and media professionals are warmly invited to engage with Paradise and the full Martin Strayd catalog today.
